mapper.select:
SELECT u.user_cd, u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.dept_cd, d.dept_nm, c.company_nm, uc.grade_cd, g.grade_nm, g.grade_level, TO_CHAR(uc.valid_from AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS valid_from, TO_CHAR(uc.valid_to AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS valid_to, uc.grant_reason, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.action_cd = 'LIST' THEN p.allow_yn END), 'N') AS list_yn, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.action_cd = 'DETAIL' THEN p.allow_yn END), 'N') AS detail_yn, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.action_cd = 'VIEW' THEN p.allow_yn END), 'N') AS view_yn, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.action_cd = 'DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL' THEN p.allow_yn END), 'N') AS download_original_yn, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.action_cd = 'PRINT' THEN p.allow_yn END), 'N') AS print_yn, COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN p.action_cd = 'MANAGE_ACL' THEN p.allow_yn END), 'N') AS manage_acl_yn FROM docs_user u LEFT JOIN docs_dept d ON d.dept_cd = u.dept_cd LEFT JOIN docs_company c ON c.company_cd = u.company_cd LEFT JOIN docs_user_security_clearance uc ON uc.user_cd = u.user_cd LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade g ON g.grade_cd = uc.grade_cd LEFT JOIN docs_user_action_permission p ON p.user_cd = u.user_cd WHERE u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N'
AND (u.user_cd ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_id ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR u.user_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR COALESCE(d.dept_nm, '') ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
GROUP BY u.user_cd, u.user_id, u.user_nm, u.dept_cd, d.dept_nm, c.company_nm, uc.grade_cd, g.grade_nm, g.grade_level, uc.valid_from, uc.valid_to, uc.grant_reason ORDER BY u.user_nm, u.user_id LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_user_security_clearance ( user_cd, grade_cd, valid_from, valid_to, grant_reason, granted_by, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{clearance.userCd}, #{clearance.gradeCd}, COALESCE( CAST(NULLIF(#{clearance.validFrom}, '') AS date)::timestamp AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ), CASE WHEN NULLIF(#{clearance.validTo}, '') IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ( CAST(#{clearance.validTo} AS date)::timestamp + INTERVAL '1 day' - INTERVAL '1 microsecond' ) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Seoul' END, #{clearance.grantReason}, #{actorUserCd}, #{actorUserCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (user_cd) DO UPDATE SET grade_cd = EXCLUDED.grade_cd, valid_from = EXCLUDED.valid_from, valid_to = EXCLUDED.valid_to, grant_reason = EXCLUDED.grant_reason, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP

SELECT 'DXF'::varchar AS object_type, f.object_id, COALESCE(f.file_no, '*') AS file_no, COALESCE(d.document_no, f.object_id) AS object_no, COALESCE(d.document_nm, '') AS object_nm, COALESCE(f.org_file_nm, f.file_nm) AS org_file_nm FROM docs_dxf_document_file f LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT document_no, document_nm FROM docs_dxf_document d WHERE d.object_id = f.object_id ORDER BY d.interface_dt DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 1 ) d ON TRUE

mapper.select:
WITH inventory AS (
) SELECT i.object_type, i.object_id, i.file_no, i.object_no, i.object_nm, i.org_file_nm, effective_label.grade_cd, effective_label.grade_nm, effective_label.grade_level, effective_label.label_reason, CASE WHEN effective_label.object_type = i.object_type AND effective_label.file_no = i.file_no THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS assigned_yn FROM inventory i LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.object_type, l.file_no, l.grade_cd, l.label_reason, g.grade_nm, g.grade_level FROM docs_file_security_label l LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade g ON g.grade_cd = l.grade_cd WHERE l.object_id = i.object_id AND ( ( l.object_type = i.object_type AND l.file_no IN (i.file_no, '*') ) OR ( l.object_type = CASE i.object_type WHEN 'DOCUMENT_SUB' THEN 'DOCUMENT' WHEN 'DRAWING_SUB' THEN 'DRAWING' WHEN 'SW_SUB' THEN 'SW' WHEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT_SUB' THEN 'PRODUCT_DOCUMENT' WHEN 'PRODUCT_SW_SUB' THEN 'PRODUCT_SW' WHEN 'DXF_SUB' THEN 'DXF' ELSE '' END AND l.file_no = '*' ) ) ORDER BY g.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN l.object_type = i.object_type AND l.file_no = i.file_no THEN 0 WHEN l.object_type = i.object_type AND l.file_no = '*' THEN 1 ELSE 2 END LIMIT 1 ) effective_label ON TRUE WHERE 1 = 1
AND (i.object_id ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.object_no ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.object_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%' OR i.org_file_nm ILIKE '%' || #{keyword} || '%')
ORDER BY i.object_no, i.file_no LIMIT 500
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_file_security_label ( object_type, object_id, file_no, grade_cd, label_reason, assigned_by, updated_by, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{label.objectType}, #{label.objectId}, #{label.fileNo}, #{label.gradeCd}, #{label.labelReason}, #{actorUserCd}, #{actorUserCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP ) ON CONFLICT (object_type, object_id, file_no) DO UPDATE SET grade_cd = EXCLUDED.grade_cd, label_reason = EXCLUDED.label_reason, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT l.grade_cd FROM docs_file_security_label l LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade ordering_grade ON ordering_grade.grade_cd = l.grade_cd WHERE l.object_id = #{objectId} AND ( ( l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no IN (#{fileNo}, '*') ) OR ( #{permissionObjectType} != #{objectType} AND l.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = '*' ) ) ORDER BY ordering_grade.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no = #{fileNo} THEN 0 WHEN l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no = '*' THEN 1 WHEN l.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = #{fileNo} THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1

WITH selected_label AS ( SELECT l.grade_cd, g.grade_nm, g.grade_level, g.use_yn AS grade_use_yn FROM docs_file_security_label l JOIN docs_security_grade g ON g.grade_cd = l.grade_cd WHERE l.object_id = #{objectId} AND ( ( l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no IN (#{fileNo}, '*') ) OR ( #{permissionObjectType} != #{objectType} AND l.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = '*' ) ) ORDER BY g.grade_level DESC, CASE WHEN l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no = #{fileNo} THEN 0 WHEN l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no = '*' THEN 1 WHEN l.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = #{fileNo} THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1 ) SELECT u.user_cd, u.user_id, u.user_nm, d.dept_nm, ug.grade_cd AS user_grade_cd, ug.grade_nm AS user_grade_nm, ug.grade_level AS user_grade_level, sl.grade_cd AS file_grade_cd, sl.grade_nm AS file_grade_nm, sl.grade_level AS file_grade_level, CASE WHEN u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(u.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS account_active_yn, CASE WHEN u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(u.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND uc.user_cd IS NOT NULL AND ug.grade_cd IS NOT NULL AND sl.grade_cd IS NOT NULL AND sl.grade_use_yn = 'Y' AND ug.grade_level >= sl.grade_level THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS grade_eligible_yn, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_user_action_permission p WHERE p.user_cd = u.user_cd AND p.action_cd IN ('LIST', 'DETAIL', 'VIEW') AND p.allow_yn = 'Y' ) = 3 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS global_view_yn, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_user_action_permission p WHERE p.user_cd = u.user_cd AND p.action_cd = 'DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL' AND p.allow_yn = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS global_download_original_yn, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_user_action_permission p WHERE p.user_cd = u.user_cd AND p.action_cd = 'PRINT' AND p.allow_yn = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS global_print_yn, CASE WHEN ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_object_user_permission p WHERE p.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND p.object_id = #{objectId} AND p.user_cd = u.user_cd AND p.action_cd IN ('LIST', 'DETAIL', 'VIEW') AND p.allow_yn = 'Y' ) = 3 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS view_yn, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_object_user_permission p WHERE p.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND p.object_id = #{objectId} AND p.user_cd = u.user_cd AND p.action_cd = 'DOWNLOAD_ORIGINAL' AND p.allow_yn = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS download_original_yn, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_object_user_permission p WHERE p.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND p.object_id = #{objectId} AND p.user_cd = u.user_cd AND p.action_cd = 'PRINT' AND p.allow_yn = 'Y' ) THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS print_yn FROM docs_user u LEFT JOIN docs_dept d ON d.dept_cd = u.dept_cd LEFT JOIN docs_user_security_clearance uc ON uc.user_cd = u.user_cd AND uc.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade ug ON ug.grade_cd = uc.grade_cd AND ug.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN selected_label sl ON TRUE WHERE ( ( u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(u.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' ) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM docs_object_user_permission existing_permission WHERE existing_permission.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND existing_permission.object_id = #{objectId} AND existing_permission.user_cd = u.user_cd AND existing_permission.allow_yn = 'Y' ) ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(u.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, u.user_nm, u.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_object_user_permission ( object_type, object_id, user_cd, action_cd, allow_yn, grant_reason, granted_by, granted_at, updated_by, updated_at ) SELECT #{request.permissionObjectType}, #{request.objectId}, u.user_cd, #{actionCd}, 'Y', #{grantReason}, #{actorUserCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, #{actorUserCd}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM docs_user u JOIN docs_user_security_clearance uc ON uc.user_cd = u.user_cd AND uc.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) JOIN docs_security_grade ug ON ug.grade_cd = uc.grade_cd AND ug.use_yn = 'Y' JOIN docs_user_action_permission global_permission ON global_permission.user_cd = u.user_cd AND global_permission.action_cd = #{actionCd} AND global_permission.allow_yn = 'Y' JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.grade_cd FROM docs_file_security_label l LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade candidate_grade ON candidate_grade.grade_cd = l.grade_cd WHERE l.object_id = #{request.objectId} AND ( ( l.object_type = #{request.objectType} AND l.file_no IN (#{request.fileNo}, '*') ) OR ( #{request.permissionObjectType} != #{request.objectType} AND l.object_type = #{request.permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = '*' ) ) ORDER BY candidate_grade.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN l.object_type = #{request.objectType} AND l.file_no = #{request.fileNo} THEN 0 WHEN l.object_type = #{request.objectType} AND l.file_no = '*' THEN 1 WHEN l.object_type = #{request.permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = #{request.fileNo} THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1 ) label ON TRUE JOIN docs_security_grade fg ON fg.grade_cd = label.grade_cd AND fg.use_yn = 'Y' WHERE u.user_cd = #{userCd} AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(u.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND ug.grade_level >= fg.grade_level ON CONFLICT (object_type, object_id, user_cd, action_cd) DO UPDATE SET allow_yn = EXCLUDED.allow_yn, grant_reason = EXCLUDED.grant_reason, updated_by = EXCLUDED.updated_by, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN u.user_cd IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN uc.user_cd IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN ug.grade_cd IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN label.grade_cd IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN fg.grade_cd IS NULL THEN FALSE WHEN permission.allow_yn IS DISTINCT FROM 'Y' THEN FALSE WHEN ug.grade_level < fg.grade_level THEN FALSE WHEN document_permission.allow_yn IS DISTINCT FROM 'Y' THEN FALSE ELSE TRUE END AS allowed, CASE WHEN u.user_cd IS NULL THEN 'NO_ACTIVE_USER' WHEN uc.user_cd IS NULL THEN 'NO_VALID_CLEARANCE' WHEN ug.grade_cd IS NULL THEN 'INACTIVE_USER_GRADE' WHEN label.grade_cd IS NULL THEN 'NO_FILE_LABEL' WHEN fg.grade_cd IS NULL THEN 'INACTIVE_FILE_GRADE' WHEN permission.allow_yn IS DISTINCT FROM 'Y' THEN 'ACTION_NOT_ALLOWED' WHEN ug.grade_level < fg.grade_level THEN 'CLEARANCE_TOO_LOW' WHEN document_permission.allow_yn IS DISTINCT FROM 'Y' THEN 'DOCUMENT_PERMISSION_NOT_GRANTED' ELSE 'ALLOW' END AS reason_cd, #{actorUserCd} AS actor_user_cd, #{actionCd} AS action_cd, #{objectType} AS object_type, #{objectId} AS object_id, #{fileNo} AS file_no, ug.grade_cd AS user_grade_cd, fg.grade_cd AS file_grade_cd, ug.grade_level AS user_grade_level, fg.grade_level AS file_grade_level, COALESCE(permission.allow_yn, 'N') AS action_allowed_yn, COALESCE(document_permission.allow_yn, 'N') AS document_permission_allowed_yn FROM (VALUES (1)) root(dummy) LEFT JOIN docs_user u ON u.user_cd = #{actorUserCd} AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(u.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' LEFT JOIN docs_user_security_clearance uc ON uc.user_cd = u.user_cd AND uc.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (uc.valid_to IS NULL OR uc.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade ug ON ug.grade_cd = uc.grade_cd AND ug.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT l.grade_cd FROM docs_file_security_label l LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade candidate_grade ON candidate_grade.grade_cd = l.grade_cd WHERE l.object_id = #{objectId} AND ( ( l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no IN (#{fileNo}, '*') ) OR ( #{permissionObjectType} != #{objectType} AND l.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = '*' ) ) ORDER BY candidate_grade.grade_level DESC NULLS LAST, CASE WHEN l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no = #{fileNo} THEN 0 WHEN l.object_type = #{objectType} AND l.file_no = '*' THEN 1 WHEN l.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND l.file_no = #{fileNo} THEN 2 ELSE 3 END LIMIT 1 ) label ON TRUE LEFT JOIN docs_security_grade fg ON fg.grade_cd = label.grade_cd AND fg.use_yn = 'Y' LEFT JOIN docs_user_action_permission permission ON permission.user_cd = u.user_cd AND permission.action_cd = #{actionCd} LEFT JOIN docs_object_user_permission document_permission ON document_permission.object_type = #{permissionObjectType} AND document_permission.object_id = #{objectId} AND document_permission.user_cd = u.user_cd AND document_permission.action_cd = #{actionCd}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM docs_user u JOIN docs_user_action_permission p ON p.user_cd = u.user_cd WHERE u.user_cd = #{userCd} AND u.use_yn = 'Y' AND u.del_yn = 'N' AND COALESCE(u.lock_yn, 'N') != 'Y' AND p.action_cd = #{actionCd} AND p.allow_yn = 'Y'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO docs_access_audit_log ( event_type, action_type, result_cd, reason_cd, result_message, actor_user_cd, actor_user_id, actor_user_nm, object_type, object_id, file_no, request_no, grade_cd, menu_cd, menu_nm, menu_url, action_nm, request_uri, http_method, http_status, duration_ms, client_ip, session_id, correlation_id, detail_json ) VALUES ( #{eventType}, #{actionType}, #{resultCd}, #{reasonCd}, #{resultMessage}, #{actorUserCd}, #{actorUserId}, #{actorUserNm}, #{objectType}, #{objectId}, #{fileNo}, #{requestNo}, #{gradeCd}, #{menuCd}, #{menuNm}, #{menuUrl}, #{actionNm}, #{requestUri}, #{httpMethod}, #{httpStatus}, #{durationMs}, #{clientIp}, #{sessionId}, #{correlationId}, CAST(COALESCE(NULLIF(#{detailJson}, ''), '{}') AS jsonb) )
